title: Ainj Howi Bibiyan Di, Hy Shaam Nu Tayyari
body:
Sir Nangay Hath Ch Rasiyaan (x2) Sajaad Hai Muhari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Maaf Kaar Sakina, Sajjad Kehkay Roya
Nayi Intazaam Main Ton, Teray Kafaan Dah Hoya
Ay Dukh Nahin Hai Bhulna (x2) Abid Nu Zindagi Saari
<<DIVIDER>>
Aj Mai Teray Shehar Vich, Ban Qaidi Agaya Han
Baba Teri Shujaat, Mai Ainj Vakha Gayan Han
Jera Touq Main Hai Paya (x2) Khaybaar Kolo Hai Bhaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaame Ghareeban Saab Nu, Dehti Rayhi Dilasay
Pehray Tai Judd Hai Ayi, Yaad Agaya Abbas Ai
Zainab Nay Jaandhi Aai (x2) Oh Raat Enj Guzaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid Dai Mezbana, Bazaar Hain Sajaye
Sirr Nungay Dhi Ali Di, Saab Loogh Vay Karayeh
Ghabragai Si Zainab (x2) Vekhi Bheer Judd Bazaari
<<DIVIDER>>
Keeta Hassan Akay Zainab, Rozay Nabi Tay Vayn Aye
Din Din Pyaasa Rak Kay, Keeta Qatal Hussainay
Jaang-e-Badar Day Badlay (x2) Chaadar Meri Utaari
